answer_1.quote: LLMs increasingly serve as decision-support systems. These domains demand models that are helpful (providing relevant and actionable guidance), harmless (avoiding toxic, biased, or unsafe outputs), and honest (grounded in factual and truthful information).
answer_1.outputs: instruction-following responses, safety refusals, factual answers
